theme_and_archetype.vibe: Energetic, stadium-like, strong typography, dramatic player-card focal points, broadcast graphics style

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data-heavy, High contrast) for dashboards. Bento-style layouts with absolute pixel-perfect alignment.

navigation.links: Bold, uppercase, subtle hover states with primary color bottom border

live_auction_card.layout: Massive split layout: Player photo takes up 50% width, stats and bidding form take up the rest.
live_auction_card.visuals: Use dynamic background gradients matching the player's role or status. Heavy use of Bebas Neue for base price and current bid.

leaderboard.layout: Vertical list, dense rows. Team logo, owner name, budget progress bar.
leaderboard.visuals: Use high contrast progress bars for budget (e.g., green for >50%, yellow for 20-50%, red for <20%).

data_tables.style: Shadcn UI table, dark mode optimized. Minimal borders, alternating row colors (bg-transparent vs bg-white/5).

buttons.primary: bg-[#EAB308] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#FACC15] transition-colors rounded-md
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md

interactions.hover: Scale up slightly (scale-105) for player cards, highlight border.
interactions.bid_update: Number ticker animation or subtle flash (bg-yellow-500/20 to transparent) when a bid is placed.

dashboard_background.description: Night cricket match crowd, used for faint atmospheric background blending.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. Use Text Shadow over images.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-bid-button', data-testid='player-row-ms-dhoni').

implementation_notes: Use pure Tailwind classes for the Live Auction grid structure (avoid Shadcn Cards for the main Hero UI to allow heavy customization).
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, selects, and tables.

The 'Bebas Neue' font should be imported via Google Fonts in index.css or via next/font if using Next.js (though environment states React). Add `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');` to the main CSS.
Ensure the polling updates do not cause the entire UI to flash. Use React state carefully.
Build the Google Drive image URL parser function to convert shareable links to direct `lh3.googleusercontent.com` or `drive.google.com/uc?id=` links.
